question.:question/problem:
Consider the augmented matrix $A,$ given by

$$
A=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}3 & 2 & -2 & -1 \\ 1 & -7 & -5 & -7 \\ -1 & 3 & -6 & -7\end{array}\right].
$$

What matrix results from carrying out the row operation $R_{1}:=-7R_{1}$ on $A?$

$$
\begin{aligned}A &= \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}3 & 2 & -2 & -1 \\ 1 & -7 & -5 & -7 \\ -1 & 3 & -6 & -7\end{array}\right]\,R_{1}:=-7R_{1} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}-7\cdot 3 & -7\cdot 2 & -7\cdot (-2) & -7\cdot (-1) \\ 1 & -7 & -5 & -7 \\ -1 & 3 & -6 & -7\end{array}\right] \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}-21 & -14 & 14 & 7 \\ 1 & -7 & -5 & -7 \\ -1 & 3 & -6 & -7\end{array}\right]\end{aligned}
$$
